summary: Community REST runtime JSON binding for create, vote, and moderation routes now composes the existing tenant-scoped SQL write-plan and transactional-outbox command seam through a local recording executor.
claim_boundary: This slice binds community create/vote/moderation JSON routes to existing service-owned REST write-plan entrypoints and records tenant-scoped SQL/outbox command execution through RecordingSqlBatchExecutor. It proves local loopback command-plan composition and response/audit metadata only. It does not connect to a live Postgres/Citus database, run SQLx transactions, drain or publish a broker outbox, prove Kubernetes Gateway/TLS/ArgoCD/OpenCost behavior, claim a live Oyatie Cloud substrate, claim remote CI green, or deploy a production tenant workload. FD-001 product delivery remains the master-plan product goal; Oyatie Cloud is the future dogfood substrate/proof point.

best_practice_research.used_for: Grounds the service-owned create_post_write_plan_from_rest, cast_vote_write_plan_from_rest, and apply_moderation_action_write_plan entrypoints used by the runtime binding.
Grounds composition of usecase receipts, tenant-scoped SQL write batches, protocol events, transport plans, and transactional outbox append.
Grounds the ordered tenant-scope command contract and RecordingSqlBatchExecutor used for loopback evidence without live database I/O.

repo_local_context.use: Before this slice, default community vote/moderation routes were honest typed_write_plan_required seams and optional BackboneCommunityJsonState bound only local in-memory vote/moderation handlers.
Community REST write-plan entrypoints already exposed SQL/outbox app plans for create, vote, and moderation.
An env-gated disposable workload harness already exercises app plans through SQLx against a supplied database; this slice deliberately stays local/recording at the REST runtime boundary.
